name: Spicy Bean and Rice Bowl
method: Cook the rice following the pack instructions, usually about 12 minutes, then drain. Drain and rinse the kidney beans and chop the pepper.
Fry the pepper in the oil for 4 minutes until soft, then stir in the paprika and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans and sweetcorn and heat through for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until piping hot.
Spoon the rice into a bowl, top with the spicy beans and scatter over the grated cheese.
